text: ATC cleared Alaska 421 to climb and maintain 11,000 ft and the pilot monitoring read back 11,000 ft. The pilot flying set 12,000 ft in the MCP and climbed, with the aircraft reaching 11,130 ft then 11,639 ft. At 35 s Crosscheck said cleared 11,000, set 12,000, which correctly called the mismatch.
